scope: Local research references for M2. Original or licensed runtime assets are required.
pathBase: repository root; sourcePaths are virtual archive paths indexing the same game's sources
patchPolicy: Last matching archive by sorted filename, following existing static inventory convention.
timePolicy: Milliseconds. Source times cover extraction and local hash checks. Index times exclude extraction. Motion decode times are validation of decoded data. Null means unmeasured.

statusValues.partial: Evidence exists and a downstream check is outstanding
statusValues.pending: Required input or check is missing
statusValues.not_applicable: Stage does not apply to this sample

selectionForM2.motionFilter: Use role=primary for first readback. Raw layer data and companion tracks require composition evidence before conversion.
selectionForM2.sharedInterfaceImpact: M2 consumes schemaVersion 1, game, purpose, role, sourcePaths and resultFiles with selectors. M0 ClipManifest and runtime interfaces require no change.

placeholder.provenance: M2 needs an original or licensed rig and authored tracks for browser integration.
